final_text: All 6 tests pass. The bug was in the collapse logic: `.replace("--", "-")` replaced only one occurrence, so `"Hello   World"` (three spaces → three dashes) collapsed to `"hello--world"`. The fix uses a loop to collapse any run of dashes into a single one. The test file and its byte contents are untouched, and no third-party dependencies were added.
